title: Asymptotically optimal spherical designs on the 2-sphere
statement:
Hardin and Sloane conjectured that the minimum number of points in a spherical $t$-design on $S^2$ satisfies

$$N(2,t)=\frac{1}{2}t^2+o(t^2)\qquad\text{as }t\to\infty.$$

title: Upper bound for Euclidean minima of abelian fields of odd prime-power conductor
statement:
Let $p$ be an odd prime number, and let $K$ be an abelian number field of conductor $p^r$. If $r\ge 2$, then
\[
M(K)\le 2^{-n}\sqrt{d_K},
\]
where $n=[K:\mathbb{Q}]$, $M(K)$ is the Euclidean minimum of $K$, and $d_K$ is the absolute value of its discriminant. In particular, Minkowski’s conjecture holds for totally real number fields of conductor $p^r$ when $p$ is odd and $r\ge 2$.
